user_limit_meaning: null explicitly discloses no user GPU-hour cap. A numeric user limit must be finite positive and the registered internal total may not exceed it.
internal_total_meaning: Finite test registration, not user authorization. 140 is a parent prospective declaration for the same finite test list; it is not a driver default or an automatic increase.
required_relation: 0 < phase_limit <= total_internal_limit; if user_GPU_hours_limit is numeric then total_internal_limit <= user_GPU_hours_limit
actual_spending_unknown: Explicit finite actual counters/reserves still required; null or absent actual budget counters cannot start execution.
remaining_controls: Whole selected plan reservation before first launch; actual success/failed exit costs plus all remaining reserves before next. Unknown missing exit cost blocks next, safe stop only at next-job boundary, no automatic retry or budget revision.
legacy_manifests: V7 continuation/recovery budgets must explicitly add both disclosure fields; old artifacts are retained, never silently assigned new semantics.
acceptance: No numerical gate or strict negative result changed; internal budget admission is not scientific acceptance.
